input.body:
Dear Miles,

Thank you for your reply about Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ (ref R/PM010-1).

Your email reached us with only your signature, and we can't see a photo attached. If you meant to attach one, it may not have come through. Please could you send it again: a clear photo of the solar panel meter/inverter display with the reading easy to read?

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

data.reasoning: This is simple enough without deeper review—the reply came back empty with no photo attached. I should ask the tenant if they meant to attach something, send that email, place a hold, and record the phone fact.

result.summary: This is a routine admin task: every 3 months the landlord wants a photo of the solar panel readings from the tenant. We've asked the tenant three times (email on 11 Jan, a call on 13 Jan, email on 17 Jan). Their latest reply (event 012) was only a signature, and no photo is visible. I emailed them to say no photo came through and asked them to send it again. I also saved their phone number and put the case on hold for 4 days.
result.situation: Recurring request for a solar panel readings photo at Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ. It's still in the intake stage and waiting on the tenant's photo. The tenant's reply on 17 Jan, three minutes after our second email, contained only 'Thanks & Regards, Miles Fletcher, 07700 900978'. The case has no attachments.
